text: 7家券商、15名从业人员被处罚，多项业务曝出合规风险 除证监系统的处罚外，央行近期对券商反洗钱等相关违规行为的处罚也在增加。
text_en: 7 securities firms and 15 practitioners were penalized, with compliance risks exposed in multiple businesses. In addition to penalties from the CSRC system, the PBOC's recent penalties on securities firms for anti-money laundering and other related violations are also increasing.
